title: ObjectGenericDAE: the Jacobians of a recorded forceUserFunction and rhsUserFunction by the one-pass derivative
author: Claude-JG
description: Revision2026c step RG9.10.4. A symbolic forceUserFunction or rhsUserFunction of ObjectGenericDAE adds the derivatives of its recording by q, q_t and y to the analytic Jacobians of the object - ODE2_ODE2, ODE2_ODE1, ODE1_ODE1, ODE1_ODE2, ODE1_ODE2_t -, computed in one pass over the recording, also in the threads (PySymbolicUserFunction::EvaluateJacobianAdd); a Python one stays numerical.
releaseNotes: A recorded forceUserFunction or rhsUserFunction of ObjectGenericDAE gives the Jacobian of the object by the one-pass derivative of the recording instead of numerical differences.
